_doc: Scenarios for verify.mjs (format in harness/design/VERIFY.md 'Scenario options' and the step list in browser.mjs runStep). Each scenario opens a fresh page (index.html?<pageQuery>) or, with kit.config.json target godot, a fresh Godot run (godotdriver.mjs; `headless: true` runs it headless, no shots or perf), runs its steps in order and fails on the first failed step, any console error, a problem a shot rule reports (debug.shotProblems) or a budget over its fail limit (harness/verify/perf_budgets.json). Keep each scenario small and about one thing. Name it <area>_<what>. Add a `_note` that says what it proves and which task added it. Look rule (P1-002): the game's default look is the signed stylised B (no --style arg). Scenarios that do not judge the look run with `"query": "style=none"` (the flat stand-in look, faster to load): hooks_contract, drive_north, drive_turn_right and coords_north_marker. The others (boot_title, perf_baseline, hooks_no_debug, street_boot, landmarks_boot, areas_boot) run the default look.

scenarios.name: boot_title
scenarios._note: Kit sample. The first screen the player sees, after the game says ready. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: hooks_contract
scenarios._note: Kit sample. Proves window.__game implements docs/GAME_HOOKS.md: state, clock, frames, input, perf, load, teleport, setCamera, timeScale and the sim hold. The ADOPT phase makes this pass first. Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: perf_baseline
scenarios._note: Kit sample. One perf window on the first scene, judged against perf_budgets.json. perfQuick keeps it in --quick; heavier perf scenes should leave perfQuick out so they run in --only and --all. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: hooks_no_debug
scenarios._note: P0-001, ported to Godot in P0-026. Web: opens the game URL without ?debug=1 in an iframe, window.__game.debug is undefined. Godot: the driver launches the game headless without --debug and no port answers (its own and the default), no debug server line, no ERROR lines (GAME_HOOKS.md Rules). The scenario's own debug run is headless (no shot). Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: drive_north
scenarios._note: P0-001. Input only: throttle 3 s of sim from heading 0, z falls by over 10 m and abs x stays under 0.5 m (north is -Z). Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: tiles_test_block_drive
scenarios._note: P1-018, streamed since P1-019. Boots on the committed test block (game/world/test_tiles, 9 tiles of the ITO flyover and Connaught Place, --tiles=test) with no data/ and no game/world/tiles/: the streamer loads the four ITO tiles round the start, the game says ready only when that ring is attached with its colliders, the car stands on a lane with a collider under it at the drawn height, and a throttle drive moves it along its heading. The load time is judged against the signed 3 s warn line (launch to ready). Does not judge the look: runs with style=none.

scenarios.name: drive_turn_right
scenarios._note: P0-001. Input only: throttle plus steer right, heading grows and x becomes positive (east is +X). Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: coords_north_marker
scenarios._note: P0-001. Camera at the origin looking north (-Z): the red north post (0,-50) must be in the centre third of the shot. The builder reads the shot. Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: street_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('street') builds the stand-in Delhi arterial (median, kerbs, service lane, signal junction, flyover ramp stub, shops, traffic, people); the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: landmarks_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('landmarks') builds one landmark stand-in per tier (hero arch, signature domed tomb, marker block) with surroundings; the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: areas_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('areas') builds the two area kit blocks (old city bazaar strip, Lutyens bungalow road) and the third person character stand-in; the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: stream_200
scenarios._note: P1-019. The streaming gate on the full pilot tiles (--tiles=full, needs npm run bake -- pilot): a scripted drive from India Gate to the Red Fort by ITO at 200 km/h for 60 s of sim. No frame over 33 ms after the first 2 s, streaming work at most 1 ms a frame at p99, at most 3 collider chunks a frame and never with a mesh step, tiles held under the cap. The drive goes on into the perf window (scene kind city). Stand-in look (style=none): the look of the streamed city is P2. Not in quick (over a minute, needs the full tiles).

scenarios.name: stream_140
scenarios._note: P1-019. Frame time while the city streams: the stream_200 drive at 140 km/h, measured by the perf window while tiles load and unload (scene kind city: draw calls warn 2,500 fail 3,500). budget: the acceptance is p95 inside the signed warn line of 10 ms, so warn is the fail line here. Stand-in look (style=none); P2 measures again with the city look.

scenarios.name: stream_teleport
scenarios._note: P1-019. Teleport to Connaught Place, the ITO crossing, Chandni Chowk and India Gate on the full pilot tiles: each answers within 2 s of sim with the ring attached, the player on the ground, and a ray down at 5 points hits a collider within 0.05 m of the drawn surface. quickMapped: a change under game/world/ pulls it into quick.

scenarios.name: stream_memory
scenarios._note: P1-019. Five minutes of sim (two laps India Gate, Connaught Place and back at 200 km/h, time scale 4) on the full pilot tiles: tiles held never pass the cap, process memory grows under 50 MB after the first lap, and back at the start the engine object count is within 2 percent of the first time. Not in quick (about 2 minutes).

scenarios.name: car_accel
scenarios._note: P1-020. 0 to 100 km/h with full throttle in 10 to 12 s of sim, input answered in 1 tick. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_top
scenarios._note: P1-020. Top speed 138 to 143 km/h with full throttle (steady: under 0.1 km/h gained in 3 s). Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_brake
scenarios._note: P1-020. Full brake from 100 km/h stops in 38 to 45 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_lock
scenarios._note: P1-020. Full right lock at a held 38 km/h turns on a radius of 6 to 8 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_kerb
scenarios._note: P1-020. A one-sided 0.15 m kerb at 40 km/h: under 10 degrees of roll, no flip, under 5 percent speed loss. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_flyover
scenarios._note: P1-020. Over the flyover deck joints at 100 km/h all wheels are in contact for at least 95 percent of the ticks. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_cost
scenarios._note: P1-020. Cost per V2 car per tick with 16 more cars driving on the course straight: the median physics iteration (scripts on the tick, the server step, the state sync; the gap between two physics frame starts in one drawn frame, so it runs windowed at time scale 4) with them less without, over 16. Acceptance 0.05 ms or less, printed with the script share. Debug hook vehicle('cost') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd).

scenarios.name: chase_cam_floor
scenarios._note: P1-020. The chase camera over a 20 s drive in the course scene: a reverse into the wall at the south end of the flyover lane, then full throttle up the 6 percent ramp, over its crest (the ramp top) onto the deck. Every drawn frame (debug vehicle('camrec')) the camera is 0.5 m or more above the vehicle, not inside geometry (a 0.1 m sphere) and no wall stands between the vehicle and the camera; six named shots (cam_start, cam_reverse, cam_wall, cam_ramp, cam_crest, cam_deck). Default look. Lockstep: one tick per frame.
